items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he told Mercer, his son, that he wanted me to be an Ellington fellow at Yale.

ctx.x: So he didn’t travel out of a suitcase.

No. I never equaled anything close to the way he traveled. It was unbelievable. But I got to see how the Duke lived. It was an experience. We became pretty good friends all through the years. Even to the end of his life, he told Mercer, his son, that he wanted me to be an Ellington fellow at Yale. “Louie Bellson and Dave, I want to be fellows. I don’t want people to think I only had black friends.”
Around this time did you also meet Stan Kenton?
